metadata.description: Product design skills by Raul Loureiro

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Seven skills for enterprise product design work. Work out what the problem actually is, sketch it as a breadboard, try two or three solution directions and pick one with a binary fit check inside a fixed time budget, wireframe the screens when layout turns out to be the real question, then write it up as a proposal someone can approve or decline. Renderers turn the result into a scrollytelling explainer or a local tldraw canvas.
